verdict.rationale: Square documents a Locations API for location management, noting that more locations can be created beyond the default one. An official MCP server gives an agent a path to call Square APIs. However, nothing in the evidence shows reader/device registration or pairing via API; the Terminal API citation covers only tip settings. missing for 10: explicit API-driven location creation docs, any documented API for registering/pairing readers to a location, end-to-end agent provisioning evidence, hands-on corroboration.
